learning_outcomes.text: Enable apprentices to transition from a "student" position to a "professional" position by reflecting on their learning methods and methodologies, identifying efficient practices, exchanging among peers, and linking the two training locations: the school and the host company.
Accompany the apprentice in acquiring a better understanding of human relationships within a company so that work can become a source of fulfillment.

syllabus_topics: Use of information and communication tools

Role of the facilitator: introduce and conclude sessions, engage participants and facilitate debate, assist in the analysis of apprenticeship practices, identify critical situations, help apprentices find solutions, report information to the ITII.

Session flow example: announcing session objective (identify good practices for apprentice integration), small group discussion on integration paths (strengths/weaknesses), plenary restitution for identifying favorable actions, plenary discussion on lived situations, identification of action plans, session conclusion, selection of next session's theme.
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
